name: Zoom Slides
desc: Builds a deck from a prompt, a Zoom Canvas or meeting content.
desc_zh: 一句话、一份文档或一场会议就能生成整套幻灯片
solves: A blank deck after every call wastes an hour on layout. Zoom Slides drafts the presentation from the meeting itself and exports to .pptx.
solves_zh: 开完会面对空白演示文稿，一小时都耗在排版上。Zoom Slides 直接根据会议内容生成初稿，可导出 .pptx。
best_for: A client call just ended and the proposal deck is due before dinner.
best_for_zh: 客户会刚结束，而方案演示稿今晚之前就要交。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://www.zoom.com/en/products/whats-new/ (product timeline, June 2026), t）。 Launched with the Zoom AI Productivity Suite on 2026-06-01; the suite also contains Zoom Canvas (formerly Zoom Docs), Zoom Sheets and Zoom Paper. The What's New timeline lists it in June 2026 and says it can generate a deck from a prompt, a Zoom Canvas or meeting content. No media source was read. 首次公开日期来源：https://news.zoom.com/zoom-launches-ai-productivity-suite/
